tests.stimulus: Native HTTPS request with real ConnectInfo, then same request without transport metadata.
tests.required_observation: Real socket peer is recognized; missing metadata fails closed before body/access mutation.
tests.negative_control: Replace missing peer with localhost/default shared identity.

tests.stimulus: One peer floods public and private lanes; a distinct peer performs valid requests.
tests.required_observation: Source/global rate bounds and source concurrency caps hold; all low-rate honest requests in frozen trace are admitted.
tests.negative_control: Delete peer bucket; or debit global token before checking peer eligibility.

tests.stimulus: Slow bodies from one source fill its own request allowance.
tests.required_observation: Public source holds <=2 of 8 slots; private source <=4 of16; another peer retains admission headroom.
tests.negative_control: Apply rate limits but omit per-peer in-flight caps.

tests.stimulus: Same TCP peer rotates X-Forwarded-For, Forwarded, X-Real-IP and source port.
tests.required_observation: All requests debit the same trusted peer key.
tests.negative_control: Use header or source port in PeerKey.

tests.stimulus: Compare IPv4, IPv4-mapped IPv6, and multiple addresses within one IPv6 /64.
tests.required_observation: v4-mapped address shares IPv4 bucket; configured /64 grouping is enforced.
tests.negative_control: Key raw SocketAddr or rotate /128 within prefix.

tests.stimulus: t=999ms/1001ms boundary, large elapsed time, repeated same time, backward injected time.
tests.required_observation: No fixed-window double burst; integer credit invariant holds; backward time gives no credit.
tests.negative_control: Reset at wall-clock second or use wrapping time arithmetic.

tests.stimulus: Fill 1024 peer entries; hold leases; attempt churn/expiry/recreation.
tests.required_observation: No live entry evicted; no debt reset; no more than1024 entries; existing peers remain serviceable.
tests.negative_control: Evict an indebted/live entry and recreate it with full burst.

tests.stimulus: Drop waiter mid-body, handler error, task abort, panic in isolated fixture.
tests.required_observation: Every owned request permit releases exactly once; no counter underflow or leaked admission.
tests.negative_control: Retain manual counter decrement after handler return.

tests.stimulus: Unauthorized request triggers slow denial audit; policy changes during read.
tests.required_observation: Outer private guard covers audit; original scope and final authority recheck still enforce denial.
tests.negative_control: Drop guard before record_denial; remove final recheck.

tests.stimulus: Sustained limiter rejections at registered bound.
tests.required_observation: Only bounded low-cardinality counters; no token/IP/path payloads or durable write per rejection.
tests.negative_control: Persist every429 with supplied path/token.

tests.stimulus: Production defaults and reduced test policy under deterministic clock.
tests.required_observation: Public8/s burst8 global,2/s burst4 peer; private32/s burst32 global,8/s burst8 peer; table1024.
tests.negative_control: Accidentally expose test-only override via environment.

tests.stimulus: Invalid/duplicate cookie, invalid bearer, bad CSRF/origin, stale version, revoked/expired/delegated credentials.
tests.required_observation: No authorization or session-semantic regression; body remains unread for header-stage rejection.
tests.negative_control: Treat admission as authorization or bypass fresh verification.

tests.stimulus: Run actual native TLS fixture and packaged browser passkey login; run direct Router tests with explicit MockConnectInfo.
tests.required_observation: Production receives real peer info; test mocks never enable production fallback; login completes.
tests.negative_control: Only test request extensions by hand; native TLS path remains unconfigured.

tests.stimulus: Cancel expensive query waiter while blocking query continues.
tests.required_observation: Existing two query permits remain owned until actual query worker ends.
tests.negative_control: Release query permit when HTTP future times out.

tests.stimulus: Invoke check_listen and start with loopback/non-loopback addresses.
tests.required_observation: Both reject non-loopback; existing loopback config remains compatible.
tests.negative_control: Validate only config string, not start API.

tests.stimulus: Open 32 simultaneous connections and a33rd in synthetic loopback fixture.
tests.required_observation: At most32 connection workers; extra connection promptly closed; permit count returns to zero.
tests.negative_control: Reserve slot only after thread spawn.

tests.stimulus: Inject thread-spawn failure immediately after permit ownership transfer.
tests.required_observation: Permit is released once; listener still accepts a later valid connection.
tests.negative_control: Manual failure decrement plus RAII causes double release.

tests.stimulus: EOF, parse failure, I/O error and test panic on worker.
tests.required_observation: RAII releases slot on each exit; no manual normal-return-only accounting.
tests.negative_control: Move release back to statement following serve.

tests.stimulus: Send incomplete header bytes more frequently than inactivity timeout.
tests.required_observation: Connection closes at fixed header deadline within frozen scheduler tolerance.
tests.negative_control: Set socket timeout once; extend deadline whenever byte arrives.

tests.stimulus: Advertise valid bounded Content-Length and dribble body forever.
tests.required_observation: Absolute body deadline closes connection; no Export queued, no200.
tests.negative_control: Use read_exact with only a fixed per-read timeout.

tests.stimulus: Persistent keep-alive/pipelined requests, including already-buffered next header.
tests.required_observation: Idle/total-age/request-count limits apply even to buffered bytes; final response advertises close.
tests.negative_control: Reset connection age on each request or forget buffered path.

tests.stimulus: Peer does not read replies; induce partial writes and EAGAIN/EINTR.
tests.required_observation: Write deadline reapplied to every low-level write; closes without retrying a second response.
tests.negative_control: Unbounded write_all or timeout reset on progress.

tests.stimulus: Fill queue64 with consumer blocked, submit another complete bounded export.
tests.required_observation: Immediate overload path from try_send; never blocks before commit timer.
tests.negative_control: Restore SyncSender::send.

tests.stimulus: Enqueue succeeds; waiter expires; consumer later durably commits.
tests.required_observation: No false200 and no false assertion that data never committed; retained work follows existing custody semantics.
tests.negative_control: Delete accepted queue item on timeout or label timeout as definitely uncommitted.

tests.stimulus: Full Spool, pause, failed commit, dropped reply channel, confirmed successful commit.
tests.required_observation: Only confirmed durable successful commit yields200; error/unknown returns503 or closes.
tests.negative_control: Send200 when merely queued; spoof success after timeout.

tests.stimulus: Maximum headers/bodies/queue/32workers plus repeated reconnects under node memory cap.
tests.required_observation: Memory/tasks bounded, no growth trend after drain; report that reconnecting hostile locals can still cause denial.
tests.negative_control: Call finite connection lifetime an isolation guarantee.

tests.stimulus: Close/drop fixture listener and await all fixture workers.
tests.required_observation: Tests leave no listener/thread/scratch ownership leaks; cleanup timeout is failure.
tests.negative_control: Detach fixture threads and infer cleanup from client close.

tests.stimulus: Existing SDK-shaped protobuf requests, bad media type, duplicate length, transfer encoding, oversize request.
tests.required_observation: Existing accepted valid format and meaningful error classes preserved; limits never broadened.
tests.negative_control: Raise body cap or accept unsupported transfer encoding to pass test.

tests.stimulus: Open regular approved log through every production read/backlog entrypoint.
tests.required_observation: Same descriptor supplies fstat/identity/prefix/read; normal collection remains exact.
tests.negative_control: Securely check path, then reopen it by name.

tests.stimulus: Approved pathname is a leaf symlink to synthetic sentinel.
tests.required_observation: Read and backlog functions reject; no sentinel bytes collected.
tests.negative_control: Remove O_NOFOLLOW/NO_SYMLINKS.

tests.stimulus: Parent directory component is symlink; leaf is ordinary regular file.
tests.required_observation: Both entrypoints reject traversal; no sentinel bytes collected.
tests.negative_control: Use O_NOFOLLOW only on final component.

tests.stimulus: Use procfs magic-link path to a synthetic open FD.
tests.required_observation: Rejected by all-component policy without reading target.
tests.negative_control: Rely on regular-file fstat after following link.

tests.stimulus: FIFO with no writer, Unix socket, directory, and unprivileged /dev/null case.
tests.required_observation: No reads from nonregular source, no FIFO hang, descriptor closed.
tests.negative_control: Remove O_NONBLOCK or regular-file check.

tests.stimulus: Deterministic controlled rename before secure open and after returned descriptor.
tests.required_observation: Before-open link is rejected; after-open replacement cannot redirect existing FD; no filename reopen.
tests.negative_control: Canonicalize then open or metadata-check then open.

tests.stimulus: Rotation, truncation, invalid UTF8, oversize line, Btrfs namespace change.
tests.required_observation: Existing cursor/gap/oversize semantics retained; failures never advance unseen bytes.
tests.negative_control: Advance cursor on denied open.

tests.stimulus: Inject ENOSYS, EPERM, EINVAL and ELOOP from secure opener.
tests.required_observation: Visible per-source failure; no insecure fallback; other collectors remain available.
tests.negative_control: Retry via ordinary File::open after secure-open error.

tests.stimulus: Source aliases through an intended distribution symlink; absolute .. component; canonical explicit path.
tests.required_observation: Migration is explicit; alias rejected, canonical approved path works; no hidden scope normalization.
tests.negative_control: Auto-canonicalize or silently rewrite configured/granted paths.

tests.stimulus: Synthetic hardlink under trusted UID and synthetic replaced ordinary file.
tests.required_observation: Document/test that symlink policy is not hardlink/inode-origin authentication.
tests.negative_control: Claim all arbitrary-file redirection is prevented.

tests.stimulus: Clean hosted runner with relocated CARGO_HOME/RUSTUP_HOME and shared preflight.
tests.required_observation: Record actual launcher/toolchain paths; native/WASM pinned compiler resolves to intended storage.
tests.negative_control: Check PATH alone without rustup which or actual invocation.

tests.stimulus: Run preflight under real resource_group, with CI markers absent inside.
tests.required_observation: Self-update policy applies in shared RUSTUP_HOME; no dependency on inherited CI marker.
tests.negative_control: Fix only by setting CI in outer workflow environment.

tests.stimulus: Unmounted storage, uncapped cgroup, or wrong actual toolchain path.
tests.required_observation: Fail before builds; no /tmp/system-disk fallback and no broad env import.
tests.negative_control: Skip launcher or accept root home to green CI.

tests.stimulus: Fresh Kani install and cargo kani setup using exact pinned package.
tests.required_observation: Setup actually exits0; version and proof canary execute under intended toolchain.
tests.negative_control: Treat installed binary or cached directory as successful setup.

tests.stimulus: Assert-true canary followed by assert-false Kani canary.
tests.required_observation: Positive proof succeeds; negative proof fails for reachable assertion, not build/env error.
tests.negative_control: Accept any nonzero as a successful negative control.

tests.stimulus: Tool setup exits7 or receipt is missing/stale/partial.
tests.required_observation: Workflow fails; registry marked not_run; no successful extended receipt.
tests.negative_control: Continue-on-error or reuse older receipt.

tests.stimulus: Clean and warm-cache extended registry on target commit.
tests.required_observation: Every required check executed with current commit/digest/exit; artifacts contain matching receipts.
tests.negative_control: Check only job green or artifact existence.

tests.stimulus: PR changes only tools/ci/preflight or resource_group.py.
tests.required_observation: Extended workflow is eligible; tests validate trigger rules.
tests.negative_control: Omit those paths from top-level filter.

tests.stimulus: Required-check ruleset review with applicable and nonapplicable PRs.
tests.required_observation: No claim based on protected=true alone; no permanently-pending filtered required check.
tests.negative_control: Require filtered check without compatible trigger design.

tests.stimulus: Preflight receives irrelevant secret-like environment variables.
tests.required_observation: Only allowlisted diagnostics recorded; no complete env dump or forwarded credentials.
tests.negative_control: Import user service environment wholesale.

tests.stimulus: Replay all new negative controls against frozen checks.
tests.required_observation: Each defect fails its exact intended semantic gate; build/env errors are inconclusive.
tests.negative_control: Count any crash/nonzero as detected security defect.

tests.stimulus: Change expected outcome/oracle/spec during implementation.
tests.required_observation: Policy drift fails; separate explicit policy commit and rerun baseline required.
tests.negative_control: Weaken assertion to make candidate pass.

tests.stimulus: Run unchanged fast/extended/browser/query/delivery controls after each admitted slice.
tests.required_observation: Existing security/durability/oracle behavior remains required.
tests.negative_control: Disable failing existing test as unrelated.

tests.stimulus: Independent observer measures candidate and baseline under frozen workload.
tests.required_observation: Report p50/p95/p99, throughput, CPU, memory, FD/thread counts, cleanup and repeats; unresolved regression blocks claim.
tests.negative_control: Invent benchmark numbers or enlarge threshold after seeing result.

tests.stimulus: Rebase/HEAD movement or mismatching original blob/anchor.
tests.required_observation: Re-anchor only affected edits against new evidence; never apply stale numeric line substitutions.
tests.negative_control: Apply original line ranges to changed source.
